newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. Treasuries steady in Tokyo ahead of jobs data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries steady in Tokyo ahead of jobs data.

text.p: 0240 GMT-- *U.S. Treasuries steady by Tokyo midday with operators sidelined ahead of U.S. jobs data scheduled at 1230 GMT. *Market speculating on smaller growth in non-farm payrolls, which has provided firm support on prices recently. *Outcome of data should help determine longer term trends.
